svg.text: GOLDSMITH TECHNICAL BLUEPRINT — DUAL ENAMEL CHANNEL BAND RING
Material: 18K Yellow Gold (750) | Black Vitreous Enamel Inlay | Scale: Indicative (all dims in mm)

g.text: Repeat at 45° intervals around band (8× total)
Placed on top & bottom gold rails
Enamel: Black vitreous / cold enamel inlay
Ring size: US 9 (inner dia. 18.89 mm → round to 19 mm)
1. CASTING/TUBING: Cast or draw 18K yellow gold tube to OD 26mm × ID 19mm × length 8.2mm (allow 0.2mm finishing stock)
2. TURNING: Lathe-true outer and bore surfaces. Bore to Ø19.0mm comfort-fit bevel 0.5×45° both edges. Polish bore to mirror.
3. MILLING: Mill two circumferential channels 2.0mm wide × 1.2mm deep. Maintain 1.5mm top/bottom rails and 1.0mm centre divider.
4. ENGRAVING: Engrave 8-pt starburst (Ø3.6mm, 0.3mm deep) at 45° intervals on both gold rails (16 engravings total). Bright-cut finish.
5. ENAMEL: Apply black vitreous enamel into channels. Fire at 800°C (or use cold enamel cure 24h). Grind flush. Polish rails to high mirror.
6. FINISH: Rhodium-plate optional (avoid on enamel). Buff outer rails to high-polish. Final QC: check enamel adhesion, ring size, weight.
Tolerances: ±0.05 mm on all dimensions | Surface finish: Ra ≤ 0.2 µm on gold rails

svg.text: DRG: RING-001 | REV: A | DATE: 2026-06-13 | SCALE: NTS | UNITS: mm
